# hippobase_auth_client

Purpose: plain Dart HTTP bindings for Hippobase Auth.

This package must remain Flutter-free. Persistent session state, OAuth UI,
controllers, gates, blocs, and login widgets belong in
`hippobase_auth_flutter`.

`HippobaseAuthClient` contains public user auth bindings. Construct
`HippobaseAuthAdminClient` explicitly from
`hippobase_auth_admin_client.dart` only for admin surfaces.

Read first:
- README.md
- lib/hippobase_auth_client.dart
- lib/src/api/client.dart

Main implementation:
- lib/src/api/

Validation:
- dart analyze
- dart test
